description: This file contains unit tests for the legacy operator registration API in PyTorch's ATen tensor library. It verifies that operators with various signatures and argument types are correctly registered and callable, including tests for schema inference, argument optionality, multiple outputs, container types, and error handling for mismatched schemas.

methods.name: errorKernel
methods.description: A kernel function that should never be called, used for testing error handling.

methods.name: incrementKernel
methods.description: A simple kernel that increments an integer input.

methods.name: expectCallsIncrement
methods.description: Checks that the 'incrementKernel' kernel is correctly registered and called.

methods.description: Kernel function with no output, sets a flag when called.
